hook.head: Get better websites out of Claude.
hook.vo: Three ways to get way better websites out of Claude.

tips.vo: Upload a screenshot of a website you love, and ask Claude to match the style. It can see images, so it copies the feel, not just your words.
tips.head: Show it a screenshot.

msgs: Match this style for my café website
Got it. Dark, minimal, big photos. Building it now.

tips.vo: Most of your customers open your site from Instagram, on a phone. Tell Claude to design for a phone screen first, then desktop.
tips.head: Design for the phone first.

visual.title: prompt.txt
lines: - Then scale up to desktop
- Big buttons, easy to tap

tips.n: Number three. Make it check itself.
tips.vo: Before you call it done, ask Claude to review its own work, list what's broken, and fix it. It catches the mistakes you would miss.
tips.head: Make it check its work.

visual.prompt: > review the site, list problems, fix them

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
